name: – Joachim Streit – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: REPORT on the financial activities of the European Investment Bank Group – annual report 2025
part_text:
The European Parliament gives its opinion on how the European Investment Bank, the European Union's own lending bank, used its money in 2025. It welcomes the bank's focus on competitiveness, defence, climate and small businesses, and asks it to lend more for defence, critical raw materials, affordable housing and young farmers. It also asks for simpler loan procedures, better public scrutiny of projects, and a formal cooperation agreement between the bank and Parliament. The report does not change any law.

- The bank is asked to lend more for defence, raw materials, housing and small firms.
- It affects the bank, its borrowers, and European taxpayers whose money is at stake.
- Next, Parliament and the bank are to negotiate a formal cooperation agreement.
